info.title: OpenAsy VPN API
info.summary: Servers, users and access for OpenVPN.
info.description:
Every screen of vpn uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

vpn-server enrols once with a one-time token from `POST /api/v1/servers`, then sends its own secret (ADR 0032); `VPN_SERVER_TOKEN` still works for servers that never enrolled, and is deprecated. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

tags.name: People
tags.description: People who use the VPN, and their devices.

tags.name: Access
tags.description: Groups of people, and IP groups: the networks each group may reach.

tags.name: Product
tags.description: Version and health of this VPN.

patch.description:
Suspending removes their devices from every server at the next config pull; activating brings them back.

Needs the editor role.

delete.description:
Revokes all their devices first; the revocations stay in the CRL.

Needs the admin role.

200.description: Devices, oldest first, including revoked ones.

post.description:
Issues a certificate and a fixed VPN address, and returns the client config with the device's private key. The key is not stored: this is the only time it is shown.

Needs the editor role.

201.description: The device and its client config.

delete.description:
Adds its certificate to the CRL and removes it from every server at the next config pull.

Needs the editor role.

patch.description:
Turns the install's internal names on or off for this device; the change reaches it at its next connection.

Needs the editor role.

get.description:
From servers that reported in the last minute.

Needs the viewer role.

delete.description:
The server ends it at its next heartbeat, within 15 seconds. A device that is still allowed may connect again; revoke it or suspend the person to keep it out.

Needs the editor role.

patch.description:
Lists you send replace the current ones.

Needs the admin role.

get.description: The names every vpn-server answers to devices, under VPN_DNS_DOMAIN (ADR 0054).

post.description:
An A, AAAA or CNAME record under the internal domain. A name with a CNAME has no other record. 409 without VPN_DNS_DOMAIN.

Needs the admin role.

get.description: Its root and the certificates it issued (ADR 0054).

post.description:
A server certificate for names under the internal domain, with a new key that is returned once. 409 without VPN_DNS_DOMAIN.

Needs the admin role.

get.description:
Keys ACME clients bind their accounts with (External Account Binding), for /acme/directory.

Needs the admin role.

200.description: The keys, never their HMAC keys.

post.description:
A key id and HMAC key for one ACME client, such as Caddy or certbot. 409 without VPN_DNS_DOMAIN.

Needs the admin role.

201.description: Made; the HMAC key is shown this once.

delete.description:
The accounts bound with it are closed: their clients get no more certificates.

Needs the admin role.

get.description: For anyone to install, as PEM or, with format=der, as the .cer file Windows opens. 404 without VPN_DNS_DOMAIN.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: der for the .cer file Windows opens.

get.summary: The internal CA as an Apple profile
get.description: Installs the root on macOS, iOS and iPadOS. 404 without VPN_DNS_DOMAIN.

200.description: The internal CA as an Apple profile

get.description:
Every server added here or reporting with `VPN_SERVER_TOKEN`, with its state.

Needs the viewer role.

post.description:
Returns a one-time enrolment token for vpn-server. Once it reports, client configs made from then on list it at its address.

Needs the admin role.

delete.description:
Its secret stops working and its certificate is revoked. Client configs that list it keep trying it, then the next server.

Needs the admin role.

post.description:
For a server that lost its volume, or one still on `VPN_SERVER_TOKEN`. Its secret and the shared token stop working for it, and it gets a new certificate once it enrols.

Needs the admin role.
Called once by vpn-server with its enrolment token. The answer is the server's own secret; send it as the bearer token from then on.
Called by vpn-server every 15 seconds with its live sessions. The answer lists sessions to end now. vpn-server must have the same version as vpn (ADR 0019).

get.description: Pulled by vpn-server. Issues the server's certificate on first use. Send the last `ETag` in `If-None-Match` to get 304 when nothing changed. Contains the server's private key.

200.description: The running product and its version.

get.description:
The OpenAsy products of this install and their addresses, from `OPENASY_PRODUCTS`, for the product switcher. Empty when it is not set.

Needs the viewer role.

200.description: The products, in the order they are configured.
Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when vpn runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the vpn origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_vpn_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

serverSecret.description: A server's own secret (`ovs_...`), from `POST /api/v1/servers/enroll`. It speaks for that server only.

serverToken.description: Deprecated: `VPN_SERVER_TOKEN`, shared by every vpn-server. It speaks only for legacy servers, which never enrolled; enrol each server and use its secret instead.

adminToken.description: Deprecated: `VPN_ADMIN_TOKEN`, one shared token with the admin role and no expiry. Use an API token instead.

Problem.description: The request was refused. `code` is stable; `detail` says what to do.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

address.description: Host name or IP clients connect to; null uses `VPN_PUBLIC_HOST`.

status.description: `offline` when it has not reported for 60 seconds.

legacy.description: Reports with the deprecated `VPN_SERVER_TOKEN`. Get it an enrolment token to move it to its own secret.

lastSeen.description: Last heartbeat; null until it reports.

configVersion.description: Version of the config vpn-server applies; compare with GET /api/v1/servers/{id}/config.

Listen.description: Protocol and port the server listens on; null when its config file decides.

configVersion.description: Version of the config vpn-server applied.

sessions.description: Connected devices, from OpenVPN's management interface.

examples: vpn-server 0.0.9 does not match vpn 0.1.0; install vpn-server 0.1.0

code.description: Stable identifier to match on in code.

id.description: Opaque id; also the certificate's common name.

internalNames.description: This device: off keeps the connection it had before. It and its groups resolve the install's internal names (ADR 0054). On by default.

ovpn.description: OpenVPN client config with the private key. Save it as a .ovpn file; it is not shown again.

cidr.description: IPv4 network with host bits zero.

ports.description: Ports the server lets members reach; everything else is dropped. `any` allows every port.

fullTunnel.description: Send all of a member's traffic through the VPN. Where it may go is still set by the networks; add 0.0.0.0/0 to allow the internet.

internalNames.description: Devices that reach this group; off for any of a device's groups turns it off for that device. They resolve the install's internal names (ADR 0054). On by default.

cn.description: Device id, the certificate's common name.

allow.description: Firewall rules: where the device may go. Everything else from the device is dropped.

dns.description: Whether this device gets the internal domain's DNS; only with dns.
The internal domain and its names, when VPN_DNS_DOMAIN is set (ADR 0054).

forward.description: Ask the upstream resolver for names in the domain without a record here.

disconnect.description: Device ids whose sessions the server must end now.

deviceName.description: Null when the device was deleted while connected.

bytesIn.description: Bytes the server received from the device.

bytesOut.description: Bytes the server sent to the device.

address.description: Host name or IPv4 address clients connect to. Leave it out to use `VPN_PUBLIC_HOST`.
Host name or IPv4 address clients connect to; null uses `VPN_PUBLIC_HOST`. Client configs made before the change keep the old address.

enrollToken.description: Start vpn-server with it as `VPN_ENROLL_TOKEN`. Works once, for 7 days; it is not shown again.

token.description: The enrolment token from adding the server.

secret.description: The server's own bearer secret. vpn keeps only its hash.

name.description: Relative to the domain; @ is the domain itself.

value.description: An IPv4 address, an IPv6 address or another host name.

domain.description: VPN_DNS_DOMAIN, or null when the install serves no internal names.

forward.description: Split-horizon: names in the domain without a record here are answered by public DNS (VPN_DNS_FORWARD). Off: they do not exist on the VPN.

name.description: Relative, such as grafana, or with the domain.

domain.description: VPN_DNS_DOMAIN, or null without internal names.

root.description: The root devices install once. Its Name Constraints allow names under the domain only, and no IP address.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256, as a device shows it.

certificates.description: What it issued, newest first; keys are never kept.

names.description: Host names under the domain; *.name for a wildcard.

chain.description: The certificate and the root, PEM: what a web server serves.

key.description: The private key, PEM. Shown once and never kept.

id.description: The key id an ACME client sends (EAB kid).

lastUsedAt.description: When an account was last bound with it.

hmacKey.description: The EAB HMAC key, base64url. Shown once and kept sealed.

directory.description: The ACME directory, at the address this request came to.
